description: Node-RED language: every wire carries a JSON message like Node-RED's msg. The Reading inject sends {"payload":{"temp":31.5},"topic":"READING","room":"lab"} (payload from its settings, topic and room from its Message box). Check temp reads msg.payload with jsonNumber and replaces the payload with hot or ok; topic and room travel on. Alarm combines two inputs as typed C++ variables: bool DOOR and String CHECK, and lights the LED when the door is open and it is hot. Debug nodes show complete messages. Change the language in Settings ⚙. C/C++ code runs on the board only: in ▶ Simulate those nodes pass messages through.

config.message:
// DOOR (bool) and CHECK (String) are the inputs wired into this node.
send(DOOR && CHECK == "hot" ? 1 : 0);

tests.name: 1 A hot reading keeps its topic and room (on the board)
2 Door open while hot raises the alarm (on the board)
